article.headline: No. 16 Washington women jump to early 27-point lead, cruise past Cal State Bakersfield 85-51
article.description: — Avery Howell made six 3-pointers and scored 21 points, No. 16 Washington built a 27-point lead in the first quarter and the Huskies cruised to an 85-51 victory over Cal State Bakersfield on Thursday night.

keywords: Cal State Bakersfield Roadrunners @ Washington Huskies
article.story: SEATTLE -- — Avery Howell made six 3-pointers and scored 21 points, No. 16 Washington built a 27-point lead in the first quarter and the Huskies cruised to an 85-51 victory over Cal State Bakersfield on Thursday night. Devin Coppinger added 12 points for Washington (3-0), which shot 53% from the floor and made 15 of 33 from long range. Tilda Trygger added 11 points and grabbed a team-high seven rebounds. Mydrea Moore scored 12 points and her sister Dresha Moore had 11 for Cal State Bakersfield (1-1). Washington started the game on a 31-5 run and led 35-8 after the first quarter. The Huskies made 13 of 14 field goals that included six 3-pointers spread among five players. Howell, Coppinger and Brynn McGaughy scored seven points apiece in the opening quarter. Washington beat the Roadrunners, a 80-49 win at home on Nov. 8, 2019, in the only previous matchup. Up next Cal State Bakersfield: hosts Utah Tech on Wednesday.
